title: Chapter 641 - 641 Xia Xue; Banquet!
content:
Chapter 641 - 641 Xia Xue; Banquet!

Chapter 641 - 641 Xia Xue; Banquet!

641 Xia Xue; Banquet!

Xiong Kai’s face was covered in snot and tears. He looked extremely miserable and pitiful.

He was even banging his head on the ground.

Seeing this…

Xia Xue could not help but be at a loss. She had never encountered such a thing and quickly looked at Lin Fan for help.

Lin Fan gently patted Xia Xue’s slender shoulder and said, “I’ve bought the milk tea. Let’s go.”

“Ah… Ah… Alright,” Xia Xue replied.

Xiong Kai heard this and hurriedly said, “I beg you, please spare me…”

As he spoke, he moved to hug Lin Fan’s and Xia Xue’s feet.

At this moment, Lin Fan swept his gaze over coldly.

This sweep seemed to have completely frozen Xiong Kai, making him not dare to move at all.

He even stopped breathing.

Therefore, Lin Fan and Xia Xue continued to walk forward.

…

In the live broadcast room….

The dense barrage of comments kept rolling.

World’s Best: [So cool!]

Rain Continues: [He’s right. Yuesse Snow Tea should indeed send the drinks over! He even got someone fired! He’s so handsome, just like the male lead in those movies!]

Blooming Flowers: [Not only is he handsome, but he’s also domineering! Prince Charming! My Prince Charming!]

Ai Si: [Did you see the way he glanced at Xiong Kai? It scared Xiong Kai silly. It’s so awesome!]

Xue Feng: [It’s understandable that the Imperial Hotel fired Xiong Anqing because the general manager of the Imperial Hotel and the direct descendants of the Wang family are all very respectful to Lin Fan. Perhaps the Imperial Hotel is indebted to Lin Fan’s family or they have shares in the Imperial Hotel.

[But why did the staff of Yuesse Snow Tea bring over two cups of Ice Queen?

[Could it be that Yuesse Snow Tea is also indebted to Lin Fan’s family? Or do they have shares?]

Flourish but Not Substantial: [Owns shares of Imperial Hotel and Yuesse Snow Tea at the same time? That shouldn’t be possible, right?]

…

Impossible?

How would they know that Lin Fan did not just own the shares of Imperial Hotel and Yuesse Snow Tea?

The entire Imperial Hotel and Yuesse Snow Tea belonged to Lin Fan!

Needless to say, the Imperial Hotel had belonged to Lin Fan a thousand years ago.

As for Yuesse Snow Tea, it was formed by the reorganization of two beverage companies, Cha Yue and Snow Tea.

Lin Fan had obtained 51% of Cha Yue’s shares a long time ago.

Over the years, under the operation of the super smart watch, he directly obtained all the shares.

Later on, Snow Tea was acquired.

That was how Yuesse Snow Tea was established and became famous around the world.

…

At this moment, Lin Fan and Xia Xue were walking on the winding road.

Perhaps it was because the sun was too hot or Lin Fan’s masculine aura was too strong, Xia Xue’s entire pretty face was still red.

At this moment, Lin Fan said, “If you don’t drink it now, it won’t taste good anymore.”

Xia Xue seemed to just remember that she still had a drink in her hand. She quickly picked it up.

She looked at the little snowman on top of the drink and the snowflakes that were slowly melting like butter. She praised sincerely, “It’s so beautiful!”

As she spoke, Xia Xue’s beautiful eyes became bright.

“You like snow?” Lin Fan asked.

Xia Xue said, “Yes, it’s so pretty when the snowflakes are falling slowly. Moreover, we can have snowball fights and build snowmen when it snows. It’s so fun!”

When Xia Xue spoke, the corner of her mouth could not help but rise slightly, as if she was recalling the happy times when it snowed.

However, soon, Xia Xue said, “Unfortunately, it hasn’t snowed in Jiangbei for many years.”

As soon as she finished speaking, she slowly put the straw into the cup and sucked gently. She praised, “Delicious!”

At this moment, the scorching weather suddenly turned gloomy.

The temperature suddenly dropped.

Then, snowflakes that looked like goose feathers started to fall.

This scene shocked everyone in Jiangbei.

Xia Xue was stunned for a moment, and then she shouted excitedly, “It’s snowing!

“It’s snowing! It’s really snowing!”

As she spoke, she was like a child who had just eaten candy. She jumped and danced, spinning around.

More and more snowflakes fell on the ground, the cars by the roadside, the roofs in the distance, as well as the surrounding trees… Soon, everything was wrapped in a layer of white. It was very beautiful.

Xia Xue hurriedly bent down and quickly made a beautiful snowman on the spot.

She looked at the adorable snowman and smiled.

…

In the live broadcast room.

Countless bullet comments were rolling rapidly.

Beggar: [F*ck! Am I seeing things? Is it snowing? Is it snowing in Jiangbei? Furthermore, it’s snowing in August?]

Nameless Person: [Cany anyone from Jiangbei say something? Could this be edited?]

Chen Xiao: [It’s true! It’s really snowing in Jiangbei! It’s snowing heavily! I’m going to build a snowman. I’ve never seen such heavy snow in Jiangbei. It’s so cool!]

Prosperity: [This doesn’t make sense! It doesn’t adhere to science!]

Keeping a Dream: [Science? What’s science’s place in this world? Don’t you know about special ability users?]

The Person in My Heart: [Do you think the heavy snow in Jiangbei is caused by a special ability user? Besides, Xia Xue had just said that she liked snow, and it immediately snowed. Could it be that Mr. Lin’s doing?]

Listen to Jun: [Stop joking! This time, the snow in Jiangbei covers the entire city! If it was really done by a special ability user, then how strong are they? Alright, even if there was such a powerful person, they should at least be 40 years old. Otherwise, how could they have accumulated such a powerful ability?]

Stone Man: [I agree that this isn’t the work of a special ability user. This should just be an abnormal phenomenon. However, we should wait for the official announcement.]
